frequency_question: How often does a national government agency formally notify or announce final implementation rules to comply with a strict court deadline within a comparable short window (under 30 days)?
membership_rule: Members are cases where a supreme or high court issued a strict directive with a short compliance window (30 days or less) for a major regulatory notification. Excluded are voluntary consultations without binding judicial deadlines.
window: One month compliance window following a court order.

cases.name: EPA Air Quality Standards Compliance Directive (2012)
FDA Food Safety Modernization Act Mandated Rulemaking (2015)

provenance_note: claimed 4 hits but 0 of 6 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases; rate of 0% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases sampled from similar judicial compliance mandates; believed representative of roughly 10-12 total comparable instances in this jurisdiction.
known_gaps: Varies by specific agency bureaucratic capacity and inter-ministerial friction, which are treated as background noise under the aperture.
validity_reason: Judicial enforcement patterns and bureaucratic response times remain relatively stable over a 3-to-5 year horizon.
